Method of Attack: MASEPIE: Python malware downloader that establishes persistence by modifying Windows Registry and adding a deceptive LNK file ('SystemUpdate.lnk') to Windows Startup folder; downloads additional malware and steals data
STEELHOOK: PowerShell scripts used to steal data from Chrome-based web browsers including passwords, authentication cookies, and browsing history

OCEANMAP: C# backdoor that executes base64-encoded commands via cmd.exe, establishes persistence by creating a .URL file ('VMSearch.url') in Windows Startup folder; uses IMAP as control channel to receive commands and store results stealthily
IMPACKET: Collection of Python classes for network protocol operations used for network reconnaissance and lateral movement
SMBEXEC: Tool enabling remote command execution used for network reconnaissance and lateral movement
Impacted Systems: Windows devices infected by the malware
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious links leading to JavaScript that drops Windows shortcut files (LNK) launching PowerShell commands
